locations.label: Nathan
locations.description:
A boss fight for this map, follow the main quest to begin.
After obtaining the hard drive in the main quest, open his cage using 3 numbers found around the map in this order: Interrogation Rooms, Food Hall, Engineering.
Once entered you'll need to open the cage all at the same time if playing with multiple players.

locations.label: Meteor Landing Site
locations.description: Landing site of a meteor that can be shot down by the Void Canon trap, after activating the 2 towers with dead wire.

locations.label: Mr Peeks - Boat Race!
locations.description: Underwater there is a pink boat, with a flashing red light. Interact with it to be teleported into a boat race game and play for a reward!

locations.label: Free Perk - Whack A Crab
locations.description: Throw a grenade/molotov at the crab cage up in the trees. 4 crab spots will spawn around the island, melee them to start a small mini game, win to be rewarded with loot & perks.

locations.label: Cursed Treasure Hunt
locations.description: Break the stalagmites with a melee attack with melee macchiato equipt to begin a side quest. Collect a watch first, then go to each location on the map, defeating a HVT at each highlighted location. After returning 3 coins you will be rewarded with legendary weapons.

locations.label: Cursed Skeleton
locations.description: 1 of 3 skeletons that will spawn a HVT that drop a cursed coin, when set on fire after delivering the watch during the cursed treasure hunt.

locations.label: Sentinel Marking - Fast Travel
locations.description: Shoot the marking on the rock with the alt fire of the beamsmasher, to be teleported back to the main island.

locations.label: Oxygen Mask
locations.description: Blow up a rock underneath PaP that gives off bubbles, to uncover an oxygen mask which will greatly increase your breathing time.

locations.label: Bonus Points
locations.description: In the top right window of the bridge of the shipwreck.

locations.label: Nuke
locations.description: In the bottom left corner of the spawn window.

locations.label: Insta Kill
locations.description: Up on the ruins, left side.

locations.label: Full Power
locations.description: In a hanging square beneath the south side of the unreachable sea tower.

locations.label: Double Points
locations.description: Behind some boxes in the meeting room.

locations.label: Jumpscare
locations.description: Jump continuously after activating the elevator to have a chance at activating an alternate elevator ride down to the biolabs.

locations.label: Mega-Stuffy!
locations.description: Collect 6 stuffed animals around the map. After collecting all of them, head back here and interact with all of the animals, now located on the bunk beds. And when all are interacted with your new friend will spawn!

locations.label: Armoury
locations.description: Can be entered at any time with cool-downs in between. Used to claim loot key rewards, unlike Liberty Falls, the doors are not finite and will re-lock.

locations.label: Mr Peeks Headphones
locations.description:
1 of 3 needed for the easter egg song.

locations.label: Basketball Bonus Points
locations.description: Shoot the ball with a pack-a-punched weapon, from the east side (near engineering) in order to make it land in the hoop on the other side of the building and drop 2000 essence.

locations.label: Culinary Delight
locations.description:
Side quest involving Oil (located directly to the right of the hobs).
Fish (obtained from blowing up/shocking any fish around the map), and 5 different ingredients.
After collecting any or all of them, interacting with the pan, then waiting 1 round and interacting with the pan, will then unlock the achievement.

targets.title: Three AMP defenses
targets.description: Defend AMPs in Guard Station → Living Quarters → Bio Lab.

targets.title: Bio Lab lift & Pack-a-Punch positions
targets.description: Raise submerged Bio Lab lift → Pack-a-Punch → equip Dead Wire for the free Beamsmasher.

targets.title: Research Office entrance
targets.description: Dead Wire: lift window box → left wall → upper landing → Living Quarters → Rec Yard.

targets.title: EMF Fob → Sea Tower briefcase
targets.description: Research Office pinned zombie → EMF Fob → Sea Tower case → Resonator onto lab terminal.

targets.title: Three calibration laptops
targets.description: Activate Docks, Storage and Communications laptops; return to terminal for X/Y/Z notes.

targets.title: Research Office computer & Peck
targets.description: Enter 2X+11 → 2Z+Y−5 → absolute value of Y+Z−X.

targets.title: Research Office computer
targets.description: Wait for scan completion → retrieve Resonator → boat to Castle Rock Island.

targets.title: Castle Rock blue orb
targets.description: Castle Rock: kill orb-marked blue zombies → carry their energy into the large orb.

targets.title: Green orb → purple orb → workbench
targets.description: Pick up Resonator between stages: Castle Rock blue → Crab green → Temple purple → AMP Munition → craft.

targets.title: Four possible hard-drive tentacle traps
targets.description: Find damaged Tentacle Trap → activate and beam it → Hard Drive → Peck.

targets.title: Clock → playing card → injury sign
targets.description: Nathan code: clock hour → Mess Hall playing card → Engineering injury sign.

targets.title: Nathan’s Bio Lab chamber
targets.description: All players hold valves → defeat Nathan while circling the lab.

targets.title: Nathan keycard search
targets.description: Collect underwater Janus Keycard → Communications green-text computer.

targets.title: Shipwreck connector lockdown
targets.description: Shipwreck underside ladder → collect connector → survive lockdown.

targets.title: Three connector sockets · repair two
targets.description: Repair the two empty endpoints among Docks / Sea Caves / Crab Island → collect Hacking Device.

targets.title: Peck · hacking device
targets.description: Resupply and stage a boat before the first buoy; bomb timer follows immediately.

targets.title: Three hacking buoys
targets.description: Hack all three sea buoys within the two-minute sequence.

targets.title: Three Bio Lab bomb sites
targets.description: Bio Lab: defuse two lower bombs and one upper bomb before the five-minute match-ending timer.

targets.description: Bombs safe → finish upgrades and ammo budget → all players accept Patient 13 entrance.

targets.title: Sea Cave treasure quest start
targets.description: Melee Macchiato cave wall → captain → marked underwater watch → return it.

targets.title: Three cursed skeletons
targets.description: Burn three marked skeletons → defeat HVT Manglers → return one coin at a time.

targets.title: Six Mega-Stuffy toys
targets.description: Collect six plushies → Living Quarters beds → assemble Mega Stuffy.

targets.title: Mega-Stuffy assembly · Living Quarters
targets.description: Interact with a plush on the Living Quarters beds to summon the companion.

targets.title: Bio Lab cage challenge
targets.description: Bio Lab cages: all zombies → next round all Vermin → next round Mangler → perk.

targets.title: Spore island candidates & final Sea Cave
targets.description: Clear three spore rocks on separate rounds → clear Sea Caves spores → perk.

targets.title: Underwater rebreather
targets.description: Explode the bubbling rock under the Bio Lab lift → collect rebreather.

targets.title: Crab Island minigame trigger
targets.description: Explode central crab cage → melee each crab group → timed minigames and location-based rewards.

targets.title: Published boat-race start
targets.description: Find a blinking underwater toy boat → race through checkpoints → claim trophy.

targets.title: Cooking pan & five mapped ingredients
targets.description: Fish + Mess Hall oil + special ingredient → pan → next round eat.

targets.title: Meteor towers → Void Cannon → landing site
targets.description: PaP + Dead Wire: charge both towers → next round Void Cannon → Castle Rock meteor loot.

targets.title: Music headphones
targets.description: Headphones: Engineering / Mining Tunnels / upper Bio Lab.

targets.title: Basketball reward
targets.description: PaP shot knocks rooftop basketball into Rec Yard hoop; pool balls give a separate pickup.

targets.title: Sentinel fast-travel marking
targets.description: Beamsmasher alternate fire at Temple Island’s Sentinel drawing → return teleport.

targets.title: Elevator jumpscare
targets.description: Jump as the Holding Cells elevator closes for the optional scare sequence.

targets.title: Hidden power-up models
targets.description: Find and shoot the miniature; the usable pickup appears nearby.

targets.title: Hidden Fire Sale
targets.description: All seven hidden models → Security Overlook spawn-window barrel → Fire Sale.

targets.title: Perks & upgrade services
targets.description: Prison ↔ Bio Lab by lift; islands by raft; keep a route back to the laboratory.
